name: io.github.NovadaLabs/novada-mcp
description: Search, extract, crawl, map, research, scrape 16 platforms, browser automation, proxy — one API key.

tools.name: novada_search
tools.description: Search the web for clean, ready-to-use content — titles, URLs, snippets, reranked by relevance. For multi-source questions, use novada_research instead (faster, more thorough).

tools.name: novada_extract
tools.description: Extract content from any URL. Auto-handles Cloudflare/DataDome/Kasada via escalation (static → JS render → Browser CDP).

tools.name: novada_crawl
tools.description: Use when you need content from a bounded set of pages (up to 20) and don't have the URLs yet. Crawls BFS/DFS, extracts each page inline.

tools.name: novada_research
tools.description: One call → 3-10 parallel searches across Google/Bing/DuckDuckGo → dedup → extracts full content from top sources → returns CITED SOURCE MATERIAL (numbered passages), not a written answer. Extractive, not generative — you compose the final answer from the gathered passages.

tools.name: novada_map
tools.description: Discover URLs on a site before deciding what to read. Tries sitemap.xml first (fast), falls back to BFS crawl.

tools.name: novada_site_copy
tools.description: Copy an entire docs site/section to disk as clean markdown — one .md file per page — returning a COMPACT manifest, not page bodies. Use for a whole knowledge base on disk (offline docs ingest, RAG corpus, full-site mirror).

tools.name: novada_scrape
tools.description: Use for structured data from a specific platform — clean tabular records, not raw HTML. Supports 16 platforms (~87 operations): Amazon, Walmart, SHEIN, Google (incl. Shopping), Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yandex, X/Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, GitHub, ChatGPT, Perplexity.

tools.name: novada_scrape_amazon
tools.description: Extract structured Amazon data — product details, reviews, seller info, bestseller lists, category/brand listings — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="amazon.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_google
tools.description: Extract structured Google SERP data — organic web search, AI Mode answers, Maps place/review details, Shopping, Jobs, Hotels, Videos — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="google.com"). Returns raw structured SERP records, not a generated answer.

tools.name: novada_scrape_bing
tools.description: Extract structured Bing SERP data — organic web search, video results, news results, shopping listings — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="bing.com"). Bing is NOT a selectable engine on novada_search — this is the only intentional way to query Bing specifically.

tools.name: novada_scrape_duckduckgo
tools.description: Extract structured DuckDuckGo web search SERP data via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="duckduckgo.com"). Returns the raw organic-results SERP, with region/time/adult-content filters novada_search does not expose, not a generated answer.

tools.name: novada_scrape_yandex
tools.description: Extract structured Yandex web search SERP data via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="yandex.com"). Returns the raw organic-results SERP, with TLD/language/time-range controls novada_search does not expose, not a generated answer.

tools.name: novada_scrape_youtube
tools.description: Extract structured YouTube data — video/channel metadata, transcripts, comments, downloadable video/audio files — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="youtube.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_instagram
tools.description: Extract structured Instagram data — profiles, posts, reels, and comments — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="instagram.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_facebook
tools.description: Extract structured Facebook data — public profile pages, posts, comments, and events — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="facebook.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_tiktok
tools.description: Extract structured TikTok data — profile info, post/video details, and post lists by profile, hashtag, or search URL — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="tiktok.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_x
tools.description: Extract structured X (Twitter) data — a single post and profile lookups by username or URL — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="x.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_walmart
tools.description: Extract structured Walmart data — product details by keyword search, category URL, SKU, zip-code-specific pricing, or direct product URL — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="walmart.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_shein
tools.description: Extract structured SHEIN product data — product details by product ID or product URL — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="shein.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_linkedin
tools.description: Extract structured LinkedIn data — job listings (by location/filters, jobs search-results URL, or a single job posting URL) and company profile info by URL — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="linkedin.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_github
tools.description: Extract structured GitHub repository data — repository details by URL, or multiple repositories from a GitHub search-results URL — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="github.com").

tools.name: novada_scrape_perplexity
tools.description: Extract the actual AI-generated answer Perplexity returns for a query — by a Perplexity query URL or a raw search term — via a closed, typed `operation` enum (same engine as novada_scrape, pinned to platform="perplexity.ai"). Scrapes Perplexity's own live-rendered answer page (the model's actual response text) — NOT a web search results list and NOT an indexed-page brand-mention scan.

tools.name: novada_proxy
tools.description: Route your own HTTP requests through residential or mobile IPs — geo-targeting, IP rotation, bypassing IP-based rate limits. Returns a proxy URL, shell exports, or a curl --proxy flag.

tools.name: novada_verify
tools.description: Check whether a factual claim is supported by web sources. Runs 3 parallel searches (supporting, skeptical, fact-check angles) and returns a verdict: supported / unsupported / contested / insufficient_data.

tools.name: novada_browser
tools.description: Interact with a web page — click, fill forms, scroll, screenshot, or run JavaScript. Chain multiple actions in one call.

tools.name: novada_discover
tools.description: List all available Novada tools — name, description, category, group, and status.

tools.name: novada_browser_flow
tools.description: Simplified browser automation — 5 actions (click, scroll, wait, type, screenshot). Use only if you need this simpler interface or novada_browser is unavailable.

tools.name: novada_ai_monitor
tools.description: Search PUBLIC indexed pages on AI-company domains (chatgpt.com/openai.com, perplexity.ai, anthropic.com, etc.) for brand mentions and sentiment. NOT page-change monitoring (novada_monitor) and does NOT query live AI models — a brand absent from indexed pages may still be discussed live; this only reflects indexed-page coverage.

tools.name: novada_monitor
tools.description: Detect changes on a web page over time. Extracts content, computes a hash, and compares it with the previous check.

tools.name: novada_setup
tools.description: The onboarding concierge and first-run front door. Call this FIRST when starting out, or whenever a tool reports a missing/invalid key.

tools.name: novada_account
tools.description: Single-call account & billing dashboard. Composes wallet balance, plan balances, capture logs, and health entitlements via the `section` param.

tools.name: novada_proxy_account_create
tools.description: ⚠️ WRITE — Create a proxy sub-account. Two-step approval-token gate.

tools.name: novada_proxy_account_list
tools.description: List proxy sub-accounts (wraps developer-api POST /v1/proxy_account/list).

tools.name: novada_ip_whitelist
tools.description: Manage the proxy IP whitelist — add/list/delete/remark — for Residential (1), Unlimited (4), and Static ISP (5).

tools.name: novada_capture_apikey
tools.description: Get or reset the Capture API key (wraps POST /v1/capture/get_apikey and /v1/capture/reset_apikey).

tools.name: novada_static_ip_mgmt
tools.description: Manage static ISP IPs (wraps /v1/static_house/* developer-api endpoints).

tools.name: novada_session_stats
tools.description: Per-process / per-session usage telemetry: tool-call counts, the last-N calls, and process uptime.

tools.name: novada_search_feedback
tools.description: Record search-result quality so future ranking can learn from it. Returns a thank-you/echo confirmation with an agent_instruction.

prompts.name: research_topic
prompts.description: Deep multi-source research on any topic with optional country and focus constraints

prompts.name: extract_and_summarize
prompts.description: Extract content from one or more URLs and prepare a focused summary

prompts.name: site_audit
prompts.description: Map a website structure then extract and summarize key sections

prompts.name: scrape_platform_data
prompts.description: Scrape structured data from a specific platform (Amazon, Walmart, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.) using the Novada Scraper API

prompts.name: browser_stateful_workflow
prompts.description: Automate a multi-step browser workflow with persistent session state (login, form submission, paginated scraping)

resources.description: List of search engines available in novada_search with characteristics and recommended use cases

resources.description: Decision tree and workflow patterns for choosing between all 38 novada tools: search, extract, crawl, map, research, site_copy, scrape (+15 per-platform scrapers), proxy, verify, browser, monitor, account, setup, discover
